title: Renaming a document is UPDATE_NODE on the parent drive, not WRITE on the document itself
content:
## The gotcha

A user with `WRITE` on a document **cannot rename it**. Renaming is not part of the document's own write permission — the name lives on the drive's node entry, so renaming is an `UPDATE_NODE` operation on the **drive** document. Grant it there, not on the document.

This catches people because "rename" feels like the mildest possible edit. Structurally it is not an edit to the document at all.

## Drive operation types

For document drives specifically, these operation permissions are available:

| Operation | What it allows |
| --- | --- |
| `ADD_FILE` | Create new files within the drive |
| `ADD_FOLDER` | Create new folders within the drive |
| `DELETE_NODE` | Delete files or folders within the drive |
| `UPDATE_FILE` | Modify existing files within the drive |
| `UPDATE_NODE` | Update properties of files or folders — **including renaming documents** |
| `COPY_NODE` | Copy files or folders within the drive |
| `MOVE_NODE` | Move files or folders within the drive |

## Two orthogonal axes

Operation permissions give fine-grained control over specific actions, **separate from** the general document permission levels (`READ`, `WRITE`, `ADMIN`). They are two axes, not a hierarchy: a grant on one says nothing about the other.

Operation permissions are queried and granted per `(documentId, operationType)` pair, with both user and group grants:

```graphql
query GetOperationPermissions($documentId: String!, $operationType: String!) {
  operationPermissions(documentId: $documentId, operationType: $operationType) {
    documentId
    operationType
    userPermissions { userAddress grantedBy createdAt }
    groupPermissions { groupId group { id name } grantedBy createdAt }
  }
}
```

The list above is drive-specific. If you need operation permissions for documents of other models, look up the available operations of the installed document-model package — the operation type is just the action name, so the vocabulary is per model.

_Source: apps/academy/docs/academy/03-Build/03-BuildingUserExperiences/07-Authorization/02-DocumentPermissions.md (Powerhouse v6.2.2-dev.45)._
description: Drive operation permissions (ADD_FILE, ADD_FOLDER, DELETE_NODE, UPDATE_FILE, UPDATE_NODE, COPY_NODE, MOVE_NODE) are separate from the READ/WRITE/ADMIN levels.
